additional_documents.text: Atlas API freeze decision: public request and response schemas lock on June 10. Only security-critical corrections may merge afterward, and each exception requires migration notes.

Atlas migration rehearsal runbook: restore a production-sized snapshot in staging, execute the schema upgrade, verify document counts and checksums, measure downtime, then test rollback before launch approval.
Atlas security review tracks threat-model approval, dependency audit findings, encryption verification, and the external penetration-test signoff required before launch.

Harbor certificate renewal runbook: issue the replacement chain, deploy it to canary hosts, validate TLS handshakes from every region, rotate the remaining hosts, and confirm the seven-day expiry alert.

Credential rotation retrospective: a service cached the retired OAuth secret for twenty minutes. Future rotations require cache invalidation, dual-secret verification, and an authentication error dashboard.
Remote work FAQ: hub-assigned employees attend three anchor days weekly. Managers may vary which days by team, while approved accessibility accommodations override the standard schedule.

Workplace accommodations guide: employees can request schedule, equipment, communication, or office-access changes through the confidential accessibility process without sharing medical details with their manager.

Invoice payment process: verify the purchase order, confirm service receipt, route invoices above five thousand dollars for finance approval, and schedule payment five business days before the due date.
Acme Cloud renewal proposal: keep observability, reduce premium log retention, and negotiate a two-year price cap before the September 30 contract renewal.
Offline search reliability specification: queries must work after airplane-mode launch, corrupted indexes must produce a rebuild action, and saved indexes must restore deterministic rankings.
Swift package release checklist: build the XCFramework for device and simulator, verify checksums, test a clean Package.swift integration, tag the release, and publish migration notes.

Index corruption recovery guide: validate the snapshot, preserve the diagnostic error, remove only the damaged generation, restore a known-good copy when available, or rebuild from application-owned documents.
Background location audit: list apps with always-on access, change nonessential apps to while-in-use, disable precise location where unnecessary, and compare battery activity after one day.
Battery service guidance: replacement is recommended when maximum capacity falls below eighty percent, unexpected shutdowns continue after updates, or the operating system reports degraded health.
Japan rail planning notes: reserve Shinkansen seats during holidays, use an IC card for city transit, allow time for transfers, and forward large luggage when moving between Kyoto and Tokyo.
Kyoto autumn guide: visit Tofuku-ji for maple leaves, walk northern Higashiyama, reserve an evening temple illumination, and expect peak crowds in late November.
Photo checksum verification: calculate hashes while copying each camera card, compare both local-drive copies, record failures, and never erase the card until every file verifies.
Cloud photo backup policy: upload an encrypted third copy after both local copies verify, retain original files and metadata, and test restoration quarterly.
Espresso grinder adjustment guide: if a fixed dose runs too quickly, grind finer; if it chokes or runs slowly, grind coarser. Purge retained grounds before measuring the next shot.
Sourdough temperature notes: a starter ferments slowly below twenty-one Celsius. Use warmer water and a stable twenty-four to twenty-six degree environment before increasing feeding frequency.
Empty-state design specification: explain why no content appears, offer one primary action, keep illustration contrast accessible, and preserve keyboard focus order.

Release rollback playbook: the incident commander declares rollback, the release owner restores the previous artifact, data owners verify compatibility, and communications posts status every fifteen minutes.
Vendor data-retention policy: contracts must state deletion timelines, backup expiry, legal-hold handling, export rights, and written confirmation after account termination.

DNS troubleshooting guide: compare resolver responses, flush local caches, inspect split-horizon rules, test the authoritative server, and distinguish name-resolution failures from Wi-Fi connectivity.
